title: A university chartered in the woods
text: Federal land laws set aside a township in the Miami valley for a college. On February 17, 1809, Ohio chartered Miami University and gave it that township. The trustees were to divide the land into lots and lease them for 99 years, renewable forever, with rents revalued every fifteen years. Those rents were meant to pay for the university.
